answer: Self-funded trial jobs stop Sybils in four steps. First, a newcomer funds ten trial jobs from a $50 bond, paying each client $5. Second, clients sign receipts after delivery, so no fake history without work. Third, a client may refund and flag a fake, freezing it ninety days. Fourth, after ten clean trials paid work unlocks and the bond returns. Faking 1,000 agents needs 10,000 trials at $5 each plus $50,000 in bonds, $100,000 lost if caught. Trust is no hollow island promise: on the horizon only agents that paid to prove it stand, like a cook giving free tastings first.
